name: ALERT
intro: ALERT 是一个与模型无关的推荐解释评估基准，包含 Amazon Reviews 2023 的 15 个电商类别、2,761 个用户–商品交互，以最近购买为目标商品、此前购买为隐式偏好画像。ALERT-Gen 与 ALERT-Disc 按四项准则分别判断并多数投票，最终报告候选解释相对 PreferenceLogic 的胜率。
org: Worcester Polytechnic Institute, Amazon.com, Northwestern University, University of Notre Dame, Univ
build_method: Amazon购买记录筛选、购买历史画像、编辑团队与用户研究准则设计
intro_en: ALERT is a model-agnostic recommendation-explanation benchmark with 2,761 user-item interactions from 15 Amazon Reviews 2023 categories. It treats the latest purchase as the target item and earlier purchases as an implicit-preference profile. ALERT-Gen and ALERT-Disc judge four criteria separately, majority-vote the preferences, and report candidate win rate against PreferenceLogic.
metric_en: Win rate against the PreferenceLogic baseline
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the NAACL 2025 paper (ACL Anthology 2025.naacl-long.137) Sections 3-5 and the official bigheiniu/ALERT-LLMRecomBenchmark repository. The diagram preserves Amazon Reviews 2023, 15 categories, latest-purchase target context, earlier-purchase history without demographics or user IDs, title/user/5-star/max-200 quality filters, 2,761 interactions, the editorial and user-study-derived four criteria, PreferenceLogic baseline, Claude-3-Sonnet ALERT-Gen with A/B/C and position swaps, ArmoRM ALERT-Disc, criterion-by-criterion divide-and-majority-vote aggregation, win rate, controlled data/prompt interruptions, three expert annotators, and about 70% expert concordance.
